title: Provider selection identity
responsibility: Defines provider selection data and checks exact selection equality and explicit session-id shape.

inputs.name: sameSelection.a
inputs.description: First provider, model and effort selection to compare.

inputs.name: sameSelection.b
inputs.description: Second selection to compare without normalization.

inputs.name: validateSessionId.value
inputs.description: Explicit session id beginning with an ASCII letter/digit, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, at most 128 characters total.

outputs.name: sameSelection
outputs.description: True only when provider, model and effort all match exactly.

outputs.name: validateSessionId
outputs.description: The original session id when it matches the required shape.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the session id is empty, too long or contains an unsupported character.
